requirements.observations: All ten views agree on one compact cylindrical coupon. Top, bottom, and all four isometrics show an open centered socket; opposing upper and underside isometrics resolve a continuous internal helix through the full height. The revised 1.2 mm clearance is source-verified rather than visually measurable. The outer wall is uninterrupted, both end faces retain complete annular rims, and no clipping, fragments, or unintended holes are visible.

views.observations: Front elevation shows the full 20 mm cylindrical wall with level top and bottom edges and no exterior defects.
Rear elevation matches the front and confirms a continuous exterior wall.
Left elevation confirms the intended cylindrical envelope and flat end planes.
Right elevation agrees with the left without clipping or stray geometry.
Top view shows a centered open socket surrounded by a complete annular rim.
Bottom view shows the matching open entrance, entry bevel, and complete annular rim.
Front upper isometric clearly resolves the continuous internal trapezoidal helix and open passage.
Rear upper isometric confirms the same uninterrupted thread path and connected exterior body.
Front underside isometric shows the beveled entrance and continuous thread extending upward through the coupon.
Rear underside isometric confirms the through opening and shows no hidden fragments or wall breaks.
